param_types.unit_key: 单位稳定键；internal 为 true 时须为内部单位（internal_only），为 false 时须为可选单位；规格写 native 时也可填原版 UnitID（1–399）
param_types.rational: [分子, 分母] 正整数倍率
param_types.int_list: 整数列表；length 为固定长度，或以 min_length/max_length 给出长度范围；min/max 作用于每个元素
param_types.rational_list: [分子, 分母] 列表；min_length/max_length 为长度范围，min/max 作用于每个元素
param_types.sound_key: 音效稳定键（content.json 或模组 content.sounds 中登记，可见范围与单位动作脚本 op23 相同）
param_types.sound_list: 音效稳定键列表；min_length/max_length 为长度范围

doc.ZS: 工兵类单位：出击后修筑指定的内部单位（如召唤箱）。修筑时间按倍率调整（状态词 38，向上取整）；兵种浏览、出兵格与属性面板显示修筑完成后的单位。
doc.EN: Builder units construct the given internal unit after deployment. The construction time (status word 38, rounded up) is scaled by the multiplier. The unit viewer, deck card and status panel show the finished structure.

doc.ZS: 召唤箱类单位：按计量周期召唤指定的可选单位。首次计量（状态词 38）与后续间隔（状态词 39，含计量零值的一帧）先按 interval_multiplier、再按 interval_additional_multiplier 调整。
doc.EN: Summoning structures periodically summon the given selectable unit. The first gauge (status word 38) and later intervals (status word 39, including the zero-gauge frame) are scaled by interval_multiplier, then by interval_additional_multiplier.

doc.ZS: 召唤箱类单位：按计量周期召唤指定的内部单位（internal_only，写入数据行子单位字 41；例如只改写出场脚本的原版单位副本）。计量倍率同 summon_units：首次计量（状态词 38）与后续间隔（状态词 39，含计量零值的一帧）先按 interval_multiplier、再按 interval_additional_multiplier 调整。不可与 summon_units 同时使用。
doc.EN: Summoning structures periodically summon the given internal unit (internal_only, written to child word 41 of the data row; for example a copy of an original unit with rewritten entry scripts). The gauges are scaled as in summon_units: the first gauge (status word 38) and later intervals (status word 39, including the zero-gauge frame) by interval_multiplier, then by interval_additional_multiplier. Cannot be combined with summon_units.

doc.ZS: 召唤箱类单位受到攻击时立即召唤一次（召唤对象同 summon_units / summon_internal_unit，须同时使用其一），之后 cooldown tick 内的攻击不再召唤，冷却结束后再受攻击时召唤；原有的定时召唤照常进行，互不影响。建造中与损毁时不召唤。
doc.EN: Summoning structures summon once immediately when attacked (the unit given by summon_units or summon_internal_unit, one of which is required); attacks within the next cooldown ticks do not summon, and the next attack after the cooldown summons again. The periodic summons continue independently. No summons while under construction or destroyed.

doc.ZS: 投放与架设类单位：出击时由原生流程生成指定的内部单位（伞兵运输、迫击炮架设）。属性面板显示内部单位的数值。
doc.EN: Deployer units (paratrooper drop, mortar emplacement) spawn the given internal unit through the native flow. The status panel shows the internal unit's values.

doc.ZS: 空降中的内部单位：落地后转换为指定的可选单位、内部单位（2026-10-31 起）或原版单位（UnitID 1–399）（替代原生固定的 UnitID 45）。
doc.EN: Falling paratrooper (internal unit) turns into the given selectable unit, internal unit (since 2026-10-31) or original unit (UnitID 1–399) on landing, replacing the native fixed UnitID 45.

doc.ZS: 5 连发马克斯奈尔类编队（原生 BattleAction_McsnlFive）：领队出击后生成的 4 架僚机改为指定的内部单位（替代原生固定的 UnitID 187；该单位的基准须为 187），僚机按其自身的数据行与图集作战与绘制。
doc.EN: Regimental MH-6s formation (native BattleAction_McsnlFive): the four wingmen spawned by the leader become the given internal unit (replacing the native fixed UnitID 187; that unit must use base unit 187), and fight and draw with their own data row and atlas.

doc.ZS: 贯穿子弹：本单位发射的子弹（原生 BattleActionBullet）命中后不消失，继续飞行并依次结算之后接触的目标，直到落地或飞出射程；同一颗子弹对同一目标只结算一次（子弹记录已结算的目标，另有原生受击 ID 环）。每发命中目标数（状态词 17 / 24）须足够大（如 999），否则数到 0 时子弹的攻击框关闭。
doc.EN: Piercing shots: bullets fired by this unit (native BattleActionBullet) are not removed on a hit; they keep flying and hit each target they touch afterwards, until they reach the ground or their range. One bullet hits the same target only once (the bullet records the targets it has hit, besides the native hit-ID ring). Set the targets per shot (status words 17 / 24) high enough (for example 999); when it counts down to 0 the bullet's attack box closes.

doc.ZS: 地面木乃伊类单位改用垂吊木乃伊（UnitID 157）的发射动作：攻击时释放虫群。虫群脚本、伤害与距离由单位的精灵描述符与攻击参数决定。
doc.EN: Ground mummy units use the hanging mummy's (UnitID 157) shot action and release an insect swarm. Swarm scripts, damage and range come from the unit's sprite descriptor and attack parameters.

doc.ZS: 受击后的恢复动作改用精灵描述符中的指定动画槽（原生固定为槽 26）；用于自定义描述符把槽 26 另作他用的情形。
doc.EN: The recovery animation after being knocked back uses the given sprite-descriptor slot instead of the native slot 26, for descriptors that use slot 26 for something else.

doc.ZS: 坦克类单位的绝招喷火：喷火阶段受击时，按已喷出的时长改用收尾受击动画（alternate_knockback_animation 起 5 个槽），并由收尾弹体动画完成最后一次判定（ending_bullet_animations 依次对应起始段三组与标准收尾）。
doc.EN: Tank-class special flame attack. When knocked back during the flame, the unit switches to an ending knockback animation chosen by elapsed flame time (5 slots starting at alternate_knockback_animation), and an ending bullet animation performs the final hit (ending_bullet_animations: three early-phase groups and the standard ending).

doc.ZS: 同一次绝招的喷火对同一目标最多击退一次。
doc.EN: One special attack's flame knocks back the same target at most once.

doc.ZS: 坦克类单位的绝招状态（50）每帧沿用原生冲刺单位的地形移动流程，坡地上冲刺不悬空。
doc.EN: During the special attack state (50), tank-class units use the native dash units' terrain movement every frame, so dashes follow slopes.

doc.ZS: 马可、塔玛、英里、菲欧及其胖形态、圣诞英里、圣诞菲欧类单位：首次绝招后保留强化武器，之后的远程普通攻击使用原生绝招参数组（伤害、命中与射程），并保持持枪动作；胖英里保留大激光。与原版十类角色的行为相同。
doc.EN: Marco, Tarma, Eri, Fio, their fat forms, Christmas Eri and Christmas Fio class units keep the special weapon after the first special attack: later ranged normal attacks use the native special-attack parameter group (damage, hit and range) and keep the armed pose; Fat Eri keeps the large laser. Same behaviour as the ten stock characters.

doc.ZS: 按生命分档换外观（僵尸类单位，基准为僵尸（青年））。thresholds 为各档的生命比例（由高到低，生命低于最大生命×该比例即进入该档）；第 k 档使用精灵描述符的槽 原生槽号+16k（槽 0–2、6、7、9–12），同一动作换档时保留播放位置。transitions 中为 1 的档位先经状态 80 播放该档的槽 12（过渡动作，可在脚本中生成掉落效果与音效）。rage_stage 档起移速与普攻、绝招伤害按倍率改变（狂暴）。雪地步兵类单位（基准 182，推雪球的小兵 W.SOLDIER）同样可用：只就地换档，transitions 须全为 0，不支持狂暴（该动作类不处理状态 80，出击即不被击退）。
doc.EN: Zombie-class units (base: Zombie (Young Man)) change appearance by remaining HP. thresholds are HP fractions in descending order (HP below max HP times the fraction enters that stage). Stage k uses sprite-descriptor slot native slot + 16k (slots 0-2, 6, 7, 9-12); switching stages keeps the playback position of the same action. Stages marked 1 in transitions first play that stage's slot 12 through state 80 (a transition that can spawn drop effects and sounds from its script). From rage_stage on, move speed and normal/special damage change by the multipliers. Also available for snowball-soldier class units (base 182, W.SOLDIER): stages only switch in place, transitions must all be 0 and rage is not supported (that action class does not process state 80 and is never knocked back).

doc.ZS: 受击时不进入击退（不检查击退计量），生命归零时照常倒下。基准 200（飞行侵略者类，BattleAction_WingedInvader）同样适用（行为库 v14）；基准 192（侵略者类，UNION 四个单位）亦可使用（行为库 v34）。
doc.EN: The unit is never knocked back by hits (the knockback gauge is not checked); it still dies when HP reaches zero. Also applies to base 200 (Winged Invader class, BattleAction_WingedInvader; library v14) and base 192 (Invader class, the four UNION units; library v34).

doc.ZS: 原生每帧按横坐标为两队各取最前单位，攻击距离、阻挡与移动限制只看对方最前单位；单位落到对方最前单位之后时距离为负，原生一直攻击而攻击框内没有敌人，与其重叠的对方单位也不能越过它移动。本单位（或以本单位为对方最前单位的对方单位）的对方最前单位中心位于其中心之后时，改以其前方最近的对方单位计算攻击距离、阻挡与移动限制；资格与次序同原生。前方没有对方单位时按原生的无对方单位处理。
doc.EN: Natively each team's front unit is chosen by x position every frame, and attack distance, blocking and the movement limit only look at the opposing front unit; a unit that ends up behind that front unit gets a negative distance and keeps attacking an empty attack box, and opposing units overlapping it cannot move past it. When the opposing front unit's centre is behind this unit's centre (or behind an opposing unit whose front unit is this unit), attack distance, blocking and the movement limit use the nearest opposing unit in front instead, chosen with the native eligibility and ordering. With no opposing unit in front, the native no-enemy handling applies.

doc.ZS: 生命分档单位被击退时播放当前档的槽 14（槽 14+16k），不经槽 12 重播该档的过渡动作。原生在进入状态 80 时请求槽 12：生命已越过下一个带过渡的档位时仍播放过渡（槽 12+16k），否则为击退，改用槽 14+16k（原生 ZombieBrain 不使用槽 14）。滑行距离与时长由该脚本的 op7 与帧决定。不能与 no_knockback 同时使用。
doc.EN: When a staged-HP unit is knocked back it plays the current stage's slot 14 (slot 14+16k) instead of replaying that stage's transition from slot 12. The native code requests slot 12 when entering state 80: if HP has crossed the next stage with a transition, the transition (slot 12+16k) still plays; otherwise it is a knockback and slot 14+16k is used (native ZombieBrain never uses slot 14). The slide distance and duration come from that script's op7 commands and frames. Cannot be combined with no_knockback.

doc.ZS: 生命处于 until_stage 档之前（防具仍在）时，每次受击播放音效（两个音效时交替）。until_stage 为档数 + 1 时在所有档位都播放。
doc.EN: While HP is above stage until_stage (the armor is still on), each hit plays the sound (two sounds alternate). With until_stage equal to the number of stages + 1 the sound plays in every stage.

doc.ZS: 本单位的攻击使目标生命归零时播放音效。
doc.EN: Plays the sound when this unit's attack brings a target's HP to zero.

doc.ZS: 进入 stage 档时（该档须有过渡动作），在过渡动作的第 release_tick 帧投出指定的内部单位（以本单位等级生成，每个单位只投一次）。内部单位应为被投出的飞行单位（基准 160，thrown_flight 与 para_drop_transform）。
doc.EN: When the unit enters stage (which must have a transition), it throws the given internal unit at frame release_tick of the transition (spawned at this unit's level, once per unit). The internal unit should be a thrown flying unit (base 160 with thrown_flight and para_drop_transform).

doc.ZS: 被投出的飞行单位：从投出者位置前方 forward、高 height 处出发（世界坐标），不使用空降的固定起始高度；飞行轨迹由精灵描述符槽 8 的脚本（op7）决定，落地后转为 para_drop_transform 指定的单位。base_clearance 大于 0 时，飞行中前缘与敌方据点前缘的间距不小于该值（世界坐标）：将越过时停在该处并垂直落下，避免越过或嵌入敌方据点（2026-10-15 起被投出的小鬼为 16）。
doc.EN: Thrown flying unit: starts forward and height (world units) from the thrower instead of the fixed paratrooper drop height; the flight path comes from the slot 8 script (op7) of its sprite descriptor, and it turns into the para_drop_transform unit on landing. With base_clearance above 0 the flying unit keeps at least that gap (world units) between its front edge and the enemy base front edge: when it would pass that point it stops there and drops straight down, so it never lands inside or behind the enemy base (16 for the thrown imp since 2026-10-15).

doc.ZS: 空降 / 被投出的内部单位落地时，把当前生命交给 para_drop_transform 生成的单位（不超过其最大生命，至少 1）：落地前受到的伤害延续到落地后。本单位的生命按 hp_multiplier 设为与落地单位同等级的生命时，即为“分离时起单独记录生命”（2026-10-31 机动兵的骑手：基准 160 的生命 × 4/3 = 原版 162 冲天火箭弹兵）。
doc.EN: When the falling or thrown internal unit lands, its current HP is handed to the unit created by para_drop_transform (capped at that unit's max HP, at least 1), so damage taken before landing carries over. With hp_multiplier set so that this unit matches the landing unit's HP at the same level, HP is tracked separately from the moment of separation (2026-10-31 RIDER SOLDIER rider: base 160 HP x 4/3 = original 162 ROCKET BOMB SOLDIER).

doc.ZS: 雪地步兵类单位以爆炸属性（属性 2）被击毁时，原生 ZakoSnow 在状态 110 生成血色效果 0xff01，状态 110 与状态 100 只差这一项（两者都播放槽 13 并转入状态 140）。带此行为的单位按状态 100 处理，只播放本单位的死亡动作；火焰属性（状态 120）不变。
doc.EN: When a snow-soldier-class unit is destroyed by an explosive attack (attribute 2), the native ZakoSnow code adds the red splash effect 0xff01 in state 110; that is the only difference from state 100 (both play slot 13 and move to state 140). Units with this behaviour are handled as state 100 and only play their own death animation; fire deaths (state 120) are unchanged.

doc.ZS: 自爆：进入攻击（状态 30/40）与特殊攻击（状态 50）时按原版 HOPPER MECHA（UnitID 39）的流程处理：普通攻击播放槽 8、特殊攻击播放槽 9，动作开始即不被选为目标、不阻挡、不能再发动绝招，动作播完后单位消失（不经死亡流程，对方不获得击毁奖励）；动作中不会被击退或打断。伤害取动作开始时的攻击组（普通攻击为词 22、特殊攻击为词 29），攻击框与音效写在这两个槽的脚本中。unmirrored_from_tick ≥ 0 时，攻击动作开始后第该 tick 起按素材原朝向绘制（不随队伍翻转，单位朝向与判定不变；用于带文字的爆炸图）。
doc.EN: Self-destruct: attacks (states 30/40) and the special (state 50) follow the native HOPPER MECHA (UnitID 39) flow: the normal attack plays slot 8 and the special plays slot 9; from the start the unit is no longer targeted, does not block and cannot use its special, and it disappears when the animation ends (no death flow, no kill reward for the enemy). It cannot be knocked back or interrupted meanwhile. Damage uses the attack group active when the animation starts (word 22 for the normal attack, word 29 for the special); attack boxes and sounds go in the two slot scripts. With unmirrored_from_tick ≥ 0, from that tick of the attack animation the sprite is drawn in its original art direction (not flipped by team; the unit direction and hit boxes are unchanged), for explosion art that contains text.

doc.ZS: 本单位的攻击不命中空中单位（身体状态 NoTarget）与战场道具（UnitID 116、231、289、363），只打地面单位与据点。
doc.EN: This unit's attacks never hit air units (body state NoTarget) or stage items (UnitID 116, 231, 289, 363); they hit ground units and the base only.

doc.ZS: 行进射击：待机与行进（状态 10、20）的动作脚本中的 op22[弹体槽, 命中槽, x, y]（x、y 为素材坐标，同原生）在最近的敌方单位前缘距离不超过 range 时发射弹体，否则不发射；射击节奏由脚本中 op22 的位置决定。弹体的伤害、击退值、目标数、弹速与行程取近距参数组（词 15–21，可用 status_word_values 写入六个等级锚点），接触敌人后的啃咬照常使用普通攻击组。
doc.EN: Shooting while walking: op22[bullet slot, hit slot, x, y] (art coordinates, as in native scripts) in the idle and walk scripts (states 10 and 20) fires a bullet when the nearest enemy front edge is within range, and does nothing otherwise; the firing rhythm comes from where op22 sits in the scripts. Bullet damage, knockback value, target count, speed and travel come from the short-range group (words 15–21, settable per level anchor with status_word_values); biting on contact uses the normal attack group as usual.

doc.ZS: 气球飞行：生命分档的第 0 档为飞行段（第 1 档须有过渡动作，即放手与落地）。飞行中不被选为目标、不阻挡、不被阻挡、不被击退，也不攻击任何敌人；高度由动作脚本的受击框（op3）与帧位置表达。前缘与敌方据点前缘的间距不超过 pop_distance、生命降到第 1 档或发动绝招时放手（主动放手时生命截到第 1 档以下），播放第 1 档的过渡动作后按地面单位行动，此后不再有绝招。launch_sound 为出场时的音效（可省略）。
doc.EN: Balloon flight: HP stage 0 is the flying phase (stage 1 needs a transition: letting go and landing). While flying the unit is not targeted, does not block, is not blocked, is not knocked back and attacks nothing; its height comes from the hit boxes (op3) and frame positions in the scripts. It lets go when its front edge is within pop_distance of the enemy base front edge, when HP drops to stage 1, or when the special is used (letting go early cuts HP below stage 1); after the stage 1 transition it acts as a ground unit and has no special any more. launch_sound plays when it enters the field (optional).

doc.ZS: 炸药（原住民（鸟）类）：投出的弹体碰到敌人时立即播放 blast_animation（爆炸），落在地面时播放 fuse_animation（引信燃烧后爆炸），动画播完后消失（同原生迫击炮弹）；原生弹体碰到敌人或落地后直接消失、不爆炸。爆炸的攻击框、目标数（状态词 24/31）与音效写在这两个槽的脚本中，伤害与攻击属性取投出时的攻击组（普通攻击词 22/28，特殊攻击词 29/37）。special_spread_count 大于 0 时，动作脚本中 op22 的弹体槽在 special_spread_first 起连续 special_spread_count 个槽内的弹体（通常在特殊攻击中同时投出）以该槽为弹体动画，第 i 颗（1 起）落在 状态词 33（绝招弹体目的距离）× i / special_spread_count 处，即在射程内等距分布，射程随等级或倍率改变时落点随之改变；其余 op22 照旧，落在原生的普通攻击目的距离处（弹体动画为槽 26）。
doc.EN: Dynamite (NATIVE(BIRD) class): a thrown projectile that touches an enemy plays blast_animation (explodes at once); one that lands on the ground plays fuse_animation (the fuse burns, then it explodes); it disappears when the animation ends, as the native mortar shell does. Native projectiles of this class disappear on contact or landing without exploding. Put the blast attack box, target count (words 24/31) and sounds in these two slots; damage and attack attribute come from the attack group active at the throw (normal: words 22/28, special: words 29/37). With special_spread_count > 0, op22 calls whose bullet slot lies in the special_spread_count slots starting at special_spread_first (usually thrown together in the special attack) use that slot as the projectile animation, and the i-th one (from 1) lands at word 33 (special projectile target distance) × i / special_spread_count: evenly spread up to the range, following any change of the range by level or multipliers. Other op22 calls keep the native path and land at the native normal-attack target distance (projectile slot 26).

doc.ZS: 按攻击属性区分死亡动作（原住民（鸟）类）：原生的死亡状态 100（普通）、110（爆炸属性击杀）、120（火焰属性击杀）都播放槽 12；带此行为时 110 改为 explosion_animation、120 改为 fire_animation，100 仍为槽 12（同叛军步兵等小兵的三种死亡）。动作播完后单位消失。三个 *_variant_animation 非 0 时为对应死亡的另一版本（通常只换死亡语音）：死亡时单位横坐标取整为奇数则播放该版本，偶数则播放前者；只由当时的位置决定，回放与联机时双方结果相同。另适用于原版冲天火箭弹兵类（基准 162，BattleAction_MissileZako）：原生死亡状态 100 / 110 播放槽 13、120 播放槽 15（2026-10-31，机动兵落地的 162 副本按此换用普通兵的三种死亡语音）；带此行为时 110 改为 explosion_animation、120 改为 fire_animation，100 仍为槽 13。
doc.EN: Death animation by attack attribute (NATIVE(BIRD) class): the native death states 100 (normal), 110 (killed by an explosive attack) and 120 (killed by fire) all play slot 12. With this behaviour state 110 plays explosion_animation and 120 plays fire_animation, while 100 keeps slot 12, like the three deaths of rebel infantry. The unit disappears when the animation ends. A non-zero *_variant_animation is another version of that death (usually only the death voice differs): it plays when the unit's x coordinate, truncated to an integer, is odd at death, and the base version plays when it is even. The choice depends only on the position at that moment, so replays and both sides of an online match agree. Also available for the original ROCKET BOMB SOLDIER class (base 162, BattleAction_MissileZako): its native death states 100 / 110 play slot 13 and 120 plays slot 15 (2026-10-31: the 162 copy that the RIDER SOLDIER rider lands as uses this to get the three rebel infantry death voices); with this behaviour 110 plays explosion_animation and 120 plays fire_animation, while 100 keeps slot 13.

doc.ZS: 效果贴地：本单位以动作脚本 op12 生成的独立效果中，动作号为 animation 的效果在绘制时，各分件按其中心所在横坐标的战场地形高度上下平移（保持分件相对效果原点的纵向偏移），横向排开的火焰等效果因此沿坡道铺在地表上，不穿入地形，也不悬空。只改变绘制位置，效果对象的坐标、攻击框以及回放与联机的状态不变；动作浏览中按原样绘制。
doc.EN: Ground-hugging effect: among the independent effects this unit creates with op12 in its scripts, the effect playing animation is drawn with each sprite part shifted vertically to the battlefield terrain height at the part's centre x (keeping the part's vertical offset from the effect origin), so a row of flames or similar effects lies on the ground along slopes instead of cutting into the terrain or floating above it. Only drawing changes: the effect object's position, attack boxes and replay/online state are unchanged. The unit viewer draws the effect unchanged.

doc.ZS: 钢铁哨兵第一形态：单位以原生保留的 BattleAction_IronSlider 运行（MSD 1.46 未发布的 IRON SLIDER，UnitID 394），脚本采用 MSA 7.13.0 IRON SENTINEL 的动作记录编号（待机 6、行走 7、普通攻击 9、绝招 10、攻击后等待 11、受击后退 12、损毁 13；菜单 0–2）。核心按 MSA 处理：普通攻击的火箭（脚本编号 60）升出舞台上沿后从上沿外瞄准对方最前方单位落下，目标不在攻击距离边缘以内时落向边缘的地面，水平飞离发射点达远程投射距离（字 26）即爆炸；绝招的主炮导弹（64）、侧炮炮弹（50、56、105、111、117、124、130、136）与残片（72、73）按 MSA 编号建立；损毁动画播完后召唤 second_form 指定的内部单位（第二形态）。
doc.EN: Iron Sentinel first form: the unit runs on the native BattleAction_IronSlider kept in MSD 1.46 (the unreleased IRON SLIDER, UnitID 394), with scripts numbered as in the MSA 7.13.0 IRON SENTINEL action record (standby 6, walk 7, normal attack 9, special 10, post-attack wait 11, knockback slide 12, destruction 13; menu 0-2). The core follows MSA: normal-attack rockets (script id 60) rise off the top of the stage and come down from above onto the opposing front-most unit, aiming at the ground at the edge of the attack range when that unit is beyond it, and explode once they are the far projectile distance (word 26) away from the launch point; the special's cannon missiles (64), side-cannon shells (50, 56, 105, 111, 117, 124, 130, 136) and debris (72, 73) are created by their MSA ids; after the destruction animation the internal unit given by second_form is summoned (second form).

doc.ZS: 钢铁哨兵第二形态：单位以原生保留的 BattleAction_IronSlider_2 运行（UnitID 395），出场时设为免击退（原生与 MSA 相同）；脚本编号同 MSA（待机 17、行走 18、巨型导弹 19、损毁 21），三种攻击都发射巨型导弹（脚本编号 24）。损毁（状态 100–120）只播放槽 21、播完移除，不放原生按较小车体固定位置的爆炸；脚本中 op12 的共用效果（0xff00 起）由原生 addEffect 建立，脚本 154–158 为碎块：以 FallOut 效果建立（落地时移除），并在同处向前、向后各迸出 2 个原生破片（addEffectHahen）（v2，2026-10-30）。只用于由 iron_slider 召唤的内部单位。
doc.EN: Iron Sentinel second form: the unit runs on the native BattleAction_IronSlider_2 (UnitID 395) and is immune to knockback from its first update (as in both the native class and MSA); scripts use the MSA numbering (standby 17, walk 18, giant missile 19, destruction 21) and all three attacks launch the giant missile (script id 24). Destruction (states 100-120) only plays slot 21 and removes the unit when it ends, without the native explosions at fixed points sized for the smaller native body; shared effects (0xff00 and up) placed by op12 in the scripts are created by the native addEffect, and scripts 154-158 are debris: they are created as fall-out effects (removed on touching the ground), each throwing 2 native shards (addEffectHahen) forward and 2 backward from the same point (v2, 2026-10-30). Only for the internal unit summoned by iron_slider.

doc.ZS: 沙包类建筑（基准 4，BattleAction_Donou）：损毁动画（状态 100 / 110 / 120 播放的槽 8）播完、原生移除单位之前，在单位原点放共用爆炸效果 0xff04（同 MSA 能量核心）。损毁动画本身与移除时刻不变。
doc.EN: Sandbag-class structures (base 4, BattleAction_Donou): when the destruction animation (slot 8, states 100/110/120) has finished, the shared explosion effect 0xff04 is placed at the unit origin just before the native code removes the unit (as with the MSA energy core). The destruction animation and the removal timing are unchanged.

doc.ZS: 飞行护盾（MSA 7.13.0 FLYING SHELT 的 BattleAction_FlyingShell 按 MSD 原生飞行侵略者类实现）：飞行高度为地形之上 height；普攻与绝招的弹体由原生 WingedInvader::shotBullet 发射（op22 的第 2 个值须为 0）。普攻的陨石为 arc_first_animation 起 arc_count 个弹体槽：按脚本的弧线飞出，动画播完后换为 homing_animation 并每 tick 向最近的敌方单位转向（每 tick 最多 turn_rate，4096 为一周），速度为弹体速度，水平飞离发射点超过投射距离（字 26）后爆炸。绝招开始时按前方最近的敌方单位（远攻击距离内，字 7）定一个落点，倒数 rain_delay tick；绝招的陨石为 rain_first_animation 起 rain_count 个弹体槽：按脚本升空，倒数结束时换为 homing_animation，从落点后上方 45° 斜落到落点附近。陨石有受击框时可挡下敌方攻击，生命为本单位最大生命的 meteor_hp_percent%（绝招陨石只在下落中受伤），生命耗尽、命中敌人、落地（换为 homing_animation 之后）或存在超过 meteor_lifetime tick 时以共用爆炸 0xff04 消失。损毁时在本单位三处放共用爆炸 0xff04，之后每 tick 在 随机位置放小爆炸 0xff03，直至移除。
doc.EN: Flying shell (MSA 7.13.0 FLYING SHELT, BattleAction_FlyingShell, implemented on the native Winged Invader class): the unit flies height above the terrain; normal and special bullets are fired by the native WingedInvader::shotBullet (the second op22 value must be 0). Normal-attack meteors are the arc_count bullet scripts from arc_first_animation: they fly the scripted arc, then switch to homing_animation and turn toward the nearest enemy unit each tick (at most turn_rate per tick, 4096 per full turn) at the bullet speed, exploding once they are farther from the launch point than the projectile distance (word 26). When the special starts, a landing point is taken at the nearest enemy unit ahead within the far attack range (word 7) and a rain_delay-tick countdown starts; special meteors are the rain_count bullet scripts from rain_first_animation: they rise as scripted and, when the countdown ends, switch to homing_animation and fall at 45 degrees from above and behind onto the landing area. Meteors with a hit box block enemy attacks; their HP is meteor_hp_percent% of the unit's maximum HP (special meteors take damage only while falling). A meteor disappears with the shared explosion 0xff04 when its HP runs out, when it hits an enemy, when it touches the ground after switching to homing_animation, or after meteor_lifetime ticks. On destruction the unit places three shared explosions 0xff04 and then one small explosion 0xff03 at a random point every tick until it is removed.

doc.ZS: 蜈蚣长老（MSA 7.13.0 ELDER CENTIPEDE 的 BattleAction_Eldercentipedo，按 MSD 原生侵略者类实现）：出击后由地下出土（appear_animation），待机为 neutral_animation；移动时钻地（burrow_animation）后在地下移动（underground_animation，高度取地形，无受击框）；远距离攻击时由地下出土（emerge_animation）、喷酸（long_attack_animation，飞沫为 droplet_first_animation 起 droplet_count 个弹体，以普攻组结算，命中或落地时放 splash_animation）、收尾（long_attack_end_animation）；绝招入地（dive_animation）后大前行（march_animation）：身体为该动作脚本前 wheel_parts 条 op11 子层组成的圆环，绕单位前方 280 处转一周，各节越过地面处生成地面攻击弹体（ground_hit_animation），头部在地面以上且未转过半周时单位的攻击框跟随头部，脚本中的 march_dirt_animation 泥土在圆环上生成并同时发射飞向圆环中心的酸块（march_blob_animation，命中动作 march_blob_hit_animation，绝招组结算），转满一周后出土。出土与钻地脚本中的 ground_hit_animation / ground_hit_alt_animation 弹体为贴地的地面攻击（绝招组结算，范围内多个目标）。受击为 flinch_animation、flinch_loop_animation，击退为 knockback_animation，损毁为 death_animation（在地下时先出土）；地面以上每 10 tick 在脚下放 smoke_first_animation 起三个动作轮换的尘土；绘制按地面高度裁切（地面以下的部分不画）。动作切换在客体流程中执行，脚本第一 tick 的音效照常播放。
doc.EN: Elder Centipede (MSA 7.13.0 ELDER CENTIPEDE, BattleAction_Eldercentipedo, implemented on the native Invader class): after deployment the unit rises from the ground (appear_animation) and idles with neutral_animation; to move it burrows (burrow_animation) and travels underground (underground_animation, height taken from the terrain, no hit box); for the far attack it rises (emerge_animation), sprays acid (long_attack_animation; the droplets are the droplet_count bullet scripts from droplet_first_animation, settled with the normal attack group, leaving splash_animation when they hit or land) and recovers (long_attack_end_animation); the special dives (dive_animation) and then marches (march_animation): the body is a ring made of the first wheel_parts op11 sub-layers of that script, turning once around a point 280 ahead of the unit; where a segment crosses the ground a ground-hit bullet (ground_hit_animation) is created, the unit attack box follows the head while it is above the ground during the first half turn, every march_dirt_animation dirt burst in the script is placed on the ring together with an acid blob (march_blob_animation, hit animation march_blob_hit_animation, special group) flying toward the ring centre, and the unit rises again after the full turn. Bullets ground_hit_animation / ground_hit_alt_animation fired by the rise and burrow scripts are ground hits at terrain height (special group, several targets). flinch_animation / flinch_loop_animation are the flinch, knockback_animation the knockback and death_animation the death (rising first when underground); above the ground a dust cloud from three animations starting at smoke_first_animation is placed under the unit every 10 ticks; the unit is drawn clipped at the ground line. Animation changes run in the guest flow, so sounds on the first tick of a script play normally.

doc.ZS: 沙包类建筑（基准 4，BattleAction_Donou）：受击动作（状态 60 播放的槽 7）中开启的攻击框按普通攻击组结算（伤害字 22、击退计量字 23、目标数字 24、属性字 28），槽 7 脚本中每次开启攻击框（op4）都重建攻击 ID，框内各目标每次开启各受 1 次伤害（一个周期开启 n 次即至多 n 次伤害）。原生沙包的攻击组为 0，受击动作不造成伤害。受击动作中再次受击不重新开始动作，持续受击时动作逐个周期连续播放。
doc.EN: Sandbag-class structures (base 4, BattleAction_Donou): attack boxes opened during the hit reaction (slot 7, played in state 60) are settled with the normal attack group (damage word 22, knockback gauge word 23, target count word 24, attribute word 28); every attack box opening (op4) in the slot 7 script starts a new attack id, so each target inside the box takes damage once per opening (n openings per cycle give at most n hits). The native sandbag has attack group 0 and its hit reaction deals no damage. Hits received during the reaction do not restart it; under continuous attack the reaction plays cycle after cycle.

doc.ZS: 侵略者之王（MSA 7.13.0 INVADER KING 的 BattleAction_InvaderKing，按 MSD 原生侵略者类实现）：不步行。出击后移到敌方最前方单位前缘之后（近攻击距离 − 2）处，关卡预置时在原处，自高处落下（fall_animation），到地面时着地踏击（land_animation，按远距攻击组结算）；待机为 neutral_animation；近距攻击为 near_attack_animation；远距攻击为跃起（jump_animation）离开画面，移到同样的出场位置后落下并着地踏击；绝招为 special_start_animation → special_animation → special_end_animation，其中的天空激光（sky_laser_first_animation 起 sky_laser_count 个弹体脚本，身体段 sky_laser_body_animation）与地面激光（ground_laser_first_animation 起 ground_laser_count 个，落点效果 ground_impact_animation 之后的第二条按落点地面高度建立）以绝招组结算，判定为沿激光方向、半宽 16 的长条；击退为 knockback_animation（后滑，其中的反击激光 counter_laser_animation 射向前方最近的敌方单位所在处的地面，身体段 counter_laser_body_animation，落点放 counter_burst_animation）；受击为 flinch_animation、flinch_loop_animation；损毁为 death_animation，其中的攻击框按远距攻击组、伤害为远距攻击的 2/3、属性爆炸结算。落下、着地、跃起与绝招期间不击退。单位菜单的动作演示使用 menu_neutral_animation、near_attack_animation、menu_long_animation、menu_special_animation。动作切换在客体流程中执行。
doc.EN: Invader King (MSA 7.13.0 INVADER KING, BattleAction_InvaderKing, implemented on the native Invader class): the unit does not walk. After deployment it moves behind the front edge of the foremost enemy unit by the near attack range minus 2 (a stage-placed unit stays where it is), drops from above (fall_animation) and stomps on landing (land_animation, settled with the normal attack group); it idles with neutral_animation; the near attack is near_attack_animation; the far attack leaps off screen (jump_animation), moves to the same appearance position, drops and stomps; the special is special_start_animation -> special_animation -> special_end_animation, whose sky lasers (sky_laser_count bullet scripts from sky_laser_first_animation, body segment sky_laser_body_animation) and ground lasers (ground_laser_count scripts from ground_laser_first_animation; the second one after each ground_impact_animation is created at that point's ground height) are settled with the special group and hit along a strip of half width 16 in the beam direction; the knockback is knockback_animation (sliding back; its counter laser counter_laser_animation, body counter_laser_body_animation, aims at the ground under the nearest enemy ahead and leaves counter_burst_animation there); flinch_animation / flinch_loop_animation are the flinch; death_animation is the destruction, whose attack box is settled with the normal group at 2/3 of the normal attack damage as an explosion. The unit is not knocked back while dropping, landing, leaping or using the special. The unit menu action demo uses menu_neutral_animation, near_attack_animation, menu_long_animation and menu_special_animation. Animation changes run in the guest flow.

doc.ZS: 钢铁死亡蠕虫（MSA 7.13.0 IRON DEATH WORM 的匿名类 BattleAction_IronDeathWarm，按 MSD 原生侵略者类实现，流程按 MSA 底层代码）：不步行，不击退（MSA 全部动作关闭击退）。出击后由地下钻出（emerge_animation），其间不近距攻击、不发动绝招；待机为 neutral_animation；移动为钻入地下（burrow_animation），之后以地下行进动作（underground_animation，地面上只见土环与扬尘，不设受击框）按移速向敌方前线推移，转入待机、近距攻击或绝招时在原处钻出，为近距攻击钻出后接着掘削；近距攻击为掘削（near_attack_animation），攻击框存在期间每 tick都可再次命中同一目标（MSA EveryTimeAtk），抛出的碎块（debris_first_animation 起 debris_count 个弹体脚本）落地后按惯性弹跳、滚动（显示 debris_roll_first_animation 起与各碎块对应的动作），落地 debris_fuse tick 后或碰到敌方单位时爆炸（debris_burst_animation，伤害同碎块，碰到的目标不重复结算），播完移除；绝招为钻入（dive_animation，钻离地面飞向空中）→ 移到前线前方绝招投射距离（状态词 33）之内生命最低的敌方单位处（没有时为前线处）→ 自上方钻下（drill_animation）→ 回到原处（敌方前线已越过原处时为前线之后）钻出（绝招中的钻出，含绝招开始时在地下先于原处钻出，用 special_emerge_animation），钻入与钻击各自结算；两者的动作脚本中第 special_knockback_tick tick 之前的命中只结算伤害、不扣击退计量（缺省 60，即每 4 tick 一段时的最后一段才击退目标）。受击与攻击按部件判定：精灵描述符受击框 / 攻击框表中某条之后第 5 值为 0x57445054 的各条为该框的部件，动作脚本设定该框时，受到的攻击与本单位对敌方单位的攻击按部件矩形判定（外框仍供原生的其他用途）。损毁为 dive_animation → 自本方舞台外侧（−220 / 舞台宽度 + 220）横穿（death_move_animation，穿过敌方单位、不可接触、不可选为目标）至舞台中央 → 爆炸（death_burst_animation）后移除；爆炸中建立的损毁碎块（dead_body_first_animation 起每隔一个共 dead_body_count 个）下落到地形高度减当前帧高的一半时改播其后一个动作，播完移除。绘制时优先级低于 6 的层按地面裁切，6 以上的层（地面土环与空中碎屑）不裁切。单位菜单的动作演示中绝招钻到原处前方 250，结束后回到原处。动作切换在客体流程中执行。
doc.EN: Iron Death Worm (the anonymous BattleAction_IronDeathWarm of MSA 7.13.0 IRON DEATH WORM, implemented on the native Invader class following the MSA code): the unit does not walk and is never knocked back (MSA disables knockback in every action). After deployment it emerges from the ground (emerge_animation) and can neither attack at close range nor use the special meanwhile; it idles with neutral_animation; moving burrows into the ground (burrow_animation) and advances underground at the movement speed with underground_animation (only the dirt ring and dust show above the ground; no hit box), emerging in place when it switches to idle, the near attack or the special, and drilling right away when it emerges for the near attack; the near attack is the drill (near_attack_animation), whose attack box can hit the same target again every tick while it exists (MSA EveryTimeAtk), and whose thrown debris (debris_count bullet scripts from debris_first_animation) bounce and roll on landing (showing the matching animation from debris_roll_first_animation) and explode debris_fuse ticks after landing or on touching an enemy unit (debris_burst_animation, same damage as the debris, a target already touched is not settled again), being removed afterwards; the special dives (dive_animation, leaving the ground upwards), moves to the enemy unit with the lowest life within the special projection distance (status word 33) beyond the front line (the front line when there is none), drills down from above (drill_animation) and emerges back at its original position (behind the front line when the enemy front has passed it; the emergences within the special, including emerging in place when the special starts underground, use special_emerge_animation), the dive and the drill being settled separately; hits in either script before tick special_knockback_tick deal damage without reducing the knockback gauge (default 60: with one segment every 4 ticks, only the last segment knocks the target back). Hits are judged by parts: in the sprite descriptor hit / attack box tables, the entries following a box whose fifth value is 0x57445054 are its parts, and while an animation script has set that box, attacks it receives and its attacks on enemy units are judged against the part rectangles (the outer box still serves the other native uses). The destruction plays dive_animation, crosses from outside its own end of the stage (-220 / stage width + 220) to the stage centre (death_move_animation; passing through enemy units, untouchable and untargetable) and explodes (death_burst_animation) before removal; the wreckage created by the explosion (dead_body_count scripts every second one from dead_body_first_animation) falls until it reaches the terrain height minus half the current frame height, switches to the next animation and is removed when that ends. Layers with priority below 6 are clipped at the ground when drawn; layers of priority 6 and above (ground dirt and airborne debris) are not. In the unit menu action demo the special drills 250 ahead of the original position and returns afterwards. Animation changes run in the guest flow.

doc.ZS: 鼹鼠弹（MS7 / MSXX 任务 2 首领 Crablops 放出的钻地飞弹；原生只有 CRABLOPS 的弹体，这里做成单位）：基准 133 SPECIAL FORCE (RIDER)（BattleAction_Bike_P）。出击后播放钻入动作（burrow_animation）并转入地下潜行（underground_animation）：不被选为目标、不阻挡、不被阻挡（身体状态 DontToche、AreaThrough、NoTarget、NockbackGuard），动作不设受击框，按移速前进。敌方前线进入普攻距离（状态词 7，检测距离）或发动绝招时在原处钻出（emerge_animation：以很小的前倾角高高升起、悬停，钻出中按地面裁切绘制），此后可被选为目标、不能再发动绝招；钻出动作播完时单位移到悬停点（出土点前方 launch_forward、离地 launch_height，世界单位；冲刺动作以弹体为原点），锁定前方最近的有效敌方单位（没有时取最近者，据点亦可），转入冲刺（dash_animation）：每 tick 朝目标受击框中心飞行 dash_speed / 10；目标在途中失效时不改锁，沿原路径直线飞行；攻击框接触对方单位或据点、到达目标点或触地即爆炸（explode_animation，绝招为 special_explode_animation），爆炸动作的攻击框按进入攻击时的攻击组结算（普攻词 22、绝招词 29），播完移除，不经死亡流程（对方不获得击毁奖励）。钻出后生命耗尽时播放 death_animation（不造成伤害）后移除。不击退。单位菜单的动作演示中待机为 neutral_animation，移动为地下潜行，攻击与绝招朝前方固定点的方向直飞至地面后爆炸。
doc.EN: Mole missile (the drilling missile released by Crablops, boss of MS7 / MSXX Mission 2; natively only a CRABLOPS bullet, here a unit): base 133 SPECIAL FORCE (RIDER) (BattleAction_Bike_P). On deployment it plays burrow_animation and then travels underground (underground_animation): it is not targeted, does not block and is not blocked (body states DontToche, AreaThrough, NoTarget, NockbackGuard), the animation has no hit box, and it moves at its move speed. When the enemy front comes within the normal attack range (status word 7, the detection range) or its special is used, it emerges where it is (emerge_animation: it rises high at a slight forward angle and hovers, drawn clipped at the ground while emerging); from then on it can be targeted and can no longer use its special. When emerge_animation ends the unit moves to the hovering point (launch_forward ahead of the emerging point and launch_height above the ground, world units; the dash animation is centred on the missile), locks on to the nearest valid enemy ahead (otherwise the nearest one; the base counts) and dashes (dash_animation): each tick it flies dash_speed / 10 towards the centre of the target hit box; if the target becomes invalid on the way it keeps flying straight along its path without re-locking. It explodes when its attack box touches an enemy unit or base, when it reaches the target point or when it reaches the ground (explode_animation, special_explode_animation for the special). The explosion attack box uses the attack group active when the attack started (word 22 normal, word 29 special); afterwards the unit is removed without the death flow (no kill reward for the enemy). If its HP runs out after emerging it plays death_animation (no damage) and is removed. It is never knocked back. In the unit menu action viewer, idle is neutral_animation, moving is the underground travel, and the attack and special fly straight towards a fixed point ahead down to the ground and explode.

doc.ZS: 自爆摩托（原作 Fanatic Biker）：基准 133 SPECIAL FORCE (RIDER)（BattleAction_Bike_P）。平骑与行驶中被击毁同原生 133。敌方前线进入普攻距离（状态词 7）或发动绝招时原地停住，播放蓄力动作（charge_animation，翘起与翘头蓄力）charge_ticks tick 后转入翘头冲刺（dash_animation）：每 tick 前进 dash_speed / 10，速度每 tick 加 dash_accel / 100，上限 dash_cap / 10（世界单位）；车头与前方最近的有效敌方单位（没有时取最近者，据点亦可）的前缘相距不超过 throw_range、或冲刺达到 dash_limit tick 时播放弃车动作（eject_animation，每 tick 前进 eject_speed / 10）。弃车 eject_ticks tick 后生成骑手（rider_unit：被投出的内部单位，基准 160，thrown_flight 与 para_drop_transform），本单位转为飞行的摩托（flight_animation）：保留原有生命，可被选为目标与受伤（生命耗尽时按原生状态 100 爆炸），不阻挡、不被击退；锁定前方最近的有效敌方单位，以车身中心离地 apex 为顶点、每 tick² 重力 gravity / 100 的抛物线飞向其前缘之后 land_offset 处（世界单位）；水平抛射距离（放出时车身中心到落点）不超过 max_throw（0 为不限）：目标更远（冲刺达到 dash_limit 时）或没有目标时落在 max_throw 处；攻击框接触对方单位（空中单位在原处，地面单位与据点则车身先移到离地 40）或据点、或车身落到离地 40 以下时预约状态 100，按原生 133 的流程爆炸（共用效果 0xff04、槽 18 的攻击框）。动作演示中不生成骑手，飞行落地后回到待机。不可与 mole_missile 同用（共用 ZSpec 字 121–131）。
doc.EN: Bomb biker (the original Fanatic Biker): base 133 SPECIAL FORCE (RIDER) (BattleAction_Bike_P). Riding and being destroyed while riding work as native 133. When the enemy front comes within the normal attack range (status word 7) or the special is used, it stops and plays charge_animation (pop-up and wheelie charge) for charge_ticks ticks, then wheelie-dashes (dash_animation): it moves dash_speed / 10 per tick, accelerating by dash_accel / 100 per tick up to dash_cap / 10 (world units). When its front is within throw_range of the front of the nearest valid enemy ahead (otherwise the nearest one; the base counts) or the dash reaches dash_limit ticks, it plays eject_animation (moving eject_speed / 10 per tick) for eject_ticks ticks, then spawns the rider (rider_unit: a thrown internal unit, base 160 with thrown_flight and para_drop_transform) and becomes the flying bike (flight_animation): it keeps its HP and can be targeted and damaged (exploding through the native state 100 when its HP runs out), does not block and is not knocked back; it locks on to the nearest valid enemy ahead and flies along a parabola with the bike centre peaking apex above the ground and gravity / 100 per tick squared, landing land_offset beyond the target front (world units). The horizontal throw distance (from the bike centre at release to the landing point) is capped at max_throw (0 = no cap): when the target is farther (after the dash reaches dash_limit) or there is no target, the bike lands max_throw ahead. When its attack box touches an enemy unit or base (in place for air units; for ground units and bases the bike first moves to 40 above the ground), or the bike centre falls below 40 above the ground, it reserves state 100 and explodes through the native 133 flow (shared effect 0xff04, the slot 18 attack box). In the action viewer no rider is spawned and the unit returns to idle after landing. Cannot be combined with mole_missile (they share ZSpec words 121–131).

doc.ZS: MS7 首领 Fall Climber（2026-11-01，核心 r115）：身体位于行走线以下，地面以上只有两手与一小部分头部。根动作只隐藏根层并挂子层：左手、左前臂、左肘护盖、左上臂（优先级 1–4）、右侧同（5–8）、机体组（10，其下各部件合计 11–17），子层偏移为游戏中的静止姿势；核心每 tick 改写机体组的纵向偏移（起伏：待机为 bob_up / bob_high / bob_down / bob_low 四段的周期，移动中随步伐，幅度 bob 像素）与两手、上臂、前臂、肘护盖的偏移和转角（两手按身体沿朝向的累计位移每前进 gait 世界单位各迈一步、后退时反向迈步，抬手 lift，手底放在该手所在处的地形上；肩—肘—腕以两段反向运动学连接，腕点为前臂上端、固定在手上（相对手底中点 wrist_x/y），上臂绕肩、前臂绕肘转，肘护盖取二者转角的平均；长度、静止姿势的肩与肘为 upper_length、lower_length、shoulder_x/y、elbow_x/y，均 × 10 的素材像素，原画朝左的左侧）。整机绘制，不按地形裁切。受击按整台机体判定：两手（hand_width × hand_height，底边中点为手的子层位置）、两上臂与两前臂（upper_box / lower_box 为原画朝左的左侧静止姿势下相对肩 / 肘的 [左, 上, 右, 下] 素材像素，按该段当前转角转动后取外接矩形，右侧镜像）、机体（body_box，含髋与爪）与头部（head_x/y/width/height），后两者随起伏。手落地时播放 step_sounds（左手第 1 个、右手第 2 个，只有 1 个时两手共用，可省略）。普攻：两门炮轮流播放 attack_left_animation / attack_right_animation，脚本 op22 发射 orb_animation 的光球：自炮口（muzzle_x/y，× 10，右炮镜像）竖直上升到地形以上 shot_rise，再以 shot_speed / 10 的速度转为朝前水平直线飞行；贯穿（命中后继续飞行，同一颗光球对同一目标只结算一次，同 piercing_shots；每发命中目标数取单位的状态词 24），在每个结算的目标处放共用小爆炸；水平飞出 shot_distance 世界单位、落地或超时时放共用小爆炸后消失。burst_shots 大于 0 时，每射出 burst_shots 颗光球，该次攻击结束后的等待改为 burst_cooldown tick（原生待机，期间不发动普攻；0 为不限）。form 2 的绝招：记下位置，以 dash_speed / 10 移到敌方前线 + 朝向 × dash_ahead，播放 charge_animation 与 laser_animation（脚本 op4 分段，每段新建攻击 ID），再移回原处。form 1 不发动绝招；生命耗尽且本方据点仍在时播放 change_animation，播完在原处生成 second_form（内部单位，form 2）并移除本单位；form 2 出场时播放 change_animation，机体由低 rise 像素升到静止位置；损毁或形态转换开始后骨架冻结（不再起伏、迈步）；form 2 损毁播放 death_animation（爆炸与抛出的碎块由脚本排定）后移除。不击退。form 2 绝招的移动段（移到敌方前线与移回原处）受到的伤害乘 special_move_damage_taken / 100（核心 r116），蓄力与激光段乘 special_laser_damage_taken / 100（核心 r117）。
doc.EN: MS7 boss Fall Climber (2026-11-01, core r115): the body sits below the walk line, with only the hands and a little of the head above the ground. Root animations hide the root layer and mount sub-layers: the left hand, forearm, elbow cap and upper arm (priority 1-4), the same on the right (5-8) and the body group (10, its parts summing to 11-17), placed in the in-game rest pose. Every tick the core rewrites the body group vertical offset (bobbing: an idle cycle of bob_up / bob_high / bob_down / bob_low ticks, following the steps while moving, amplitude bob pixels) and the offsets and angles of the hands, upper arms, forearms and elbow caps (each hand takes one step per gait world units of body travel along the facing, stepping backwards when the body moves back, lifting lift; the hand bottom sits on the terrain under that hand; shoulder, elbow and wrist are joined by two-bone inverse kinematics, the wrist being the top of the forearm fixed on the hand (wrist_x/y from the hand bottom centre); the upper arm turns about the shoulder, the forearm about the elbow and the elbow cap by the mean of the two; lengths and the rest shoulder / elbow are upper_length, lower_length, shoulder_x/y, elbow_x/y, all in tenths of sprite pixels for the left side, art facing left). The whole machine is drawn without terrain clipping. Hits are judged against the whole machine: the hands (hand_width x hand_height, bottom centre at the hand layer), the upper arms and forearms (upper_box / lower_box: [left, top, right, bottom] in sprite pixels relative to the shoulder / elbow in the rest pose of the left side, art facing left; the bounding box after turning by the current angle of the segment, mirrored for the right side), the body (body_box, hips and claws included) and the head (head_x/y/width/height); the last two follow the bob. Each hand plays step_sounds when it lands (the first for the left hand, the second for the right; a single sound serves both; optional). Normal attack: the two guns alternate attack_left_animation / attack_right_animation; script op22 fires the orb_animation bullet from the muzzle (muzzle_x/y in tenths, the right gun mirrored), which rises straight up to shot_rise above the terrain and then turns to fly straight ahead, level, at shot_speed / 10. It pierces: it keeps flying after a hit and each orb hits a given target once (as piercing_shots; the hit count per shot is the unit status word 24), with the common small explosion on each target hit; after shot_distance world units of horizontal travel, on landing or on timeout it bursts and disappears. When burst_shots is above 0, after every burst_shots orbs the wait after that attack becomes burst_cooldown ticks (native neutral, no normal attack meanwhile; 0 means no limit). Form 2 special: remember the position, move at dash_speed / 10 to the enemy front line + facing x dash_ahead, play charge_animation and laser_animation (op4 segments, a new attack ID each) and move back. Form 1 cannot use its special; when its HP runs out while its own base stands it plays change_animation and then spawns second_form (internal unit, form 2) in place and removes itself; form 2 plays change_animation on entry while the body rises from rise pixels lower, and plays death_animation (explosions and thrown debris placed by the script) before removal; the rig freezes once the death or the form change starts. No knockback. During form 2's special movement (moving to the enemy front and back) damage taken is multiplied by special_move_damage_taken / 100 (core r116), and during its charge and laser by special_laser_damage_taken / 100 (core r117).

doc.ZS: MS7 任务 5 首领 UNION（2026-11-01，核心 r118；按 MSA 7.13.0 BattleAction_UnionCombine / Union1 / Union2 / Union3 的底层代码移植，解读见 docs/MS7_M5_UNITS_2026-11-01.md）。role 0 为合体单位，1–3 为 1–3 号机（内部单位），四者都写 first_unit / second_unit / third_unit （三机的内部单位键，合体单位以之生成三机并作开战预载，1、3 号机以之找到对方）。合体单位：v3 起可受伤，未隐去时受到的伤害乘 combined_damage_taken / 100（缺省 100 不减；MSA 为 Guard 不受伤）；分离时三机的当前生命按合体单位当时的生命比例继承；v4 起出场后累计 max_combined_ticks 帧仍未分离时（待机或前进中）自行开始分离（0 为不限，只在敌人进入射程时分离）；10 待机、20 前进；30 / 40 / 50 都播放分离动作 divide_animation（禁止普攻与绝招），第 split_tick 帧在本单位位置加朝向偏移处生成三机（first_offset / second_offset / third_offset，世界单位），下一帧置隐形、不可选为目标、不阻挡、不受伤并移到本方据点之后（v7 起 hidden_animation 大于 0 时改播该动作，并把小地图标记写为 0；原生绘制不看隐形，0 时停在分离动作的最后一帧）；v8 起 ground_follow_count 大于 0 时，分离动作中 split_bullet 的弹体与脚本 ground_follow_first 起 ground_follow_count 个效果（1 号机的部件，原生只水平移动）随地形升降：以该弹体的 x 为 1 号机的位置，前 16 帧由合体单位的高度渐变到该处地形，之后贴合地形，1 号机在该高度生成；三机全部消失时移除本单位（不再合体）。单位菜单的动作演示中（核心 r130 起），三机的图像已建立后（宿主演示预载）本单位即在三处偏移生成三机并改播 hidden_animation，演示近距 / 远距 / 绝招时三机同时进入该状态（1 号机没有远距），三机都结束后本单位回到待机；演示中弹体同样按弹体表建立。分离动作中脚本 split_bullet 的弹体随合体单位隐去而移除。1、3 号机：每帧互相推挤，3 号机前缘（x + spacing[1]）越过 1 号机后缘（x − spacing[2]）时把移动的一方放到相距 spacing[0] 处；30 / 40 / 50 播放 near_animation / far_animation / special_animation 后进入攻击等待；3 号机绝招第 16、40 帧各在“射程与敌方据点前缘之内”的高空投下 5 枚 bomb_bullet 炸弹。三机的绝招：所在一方由原生 AI（BattleControllerEnemy / NetEnemy）控制时可发动即自行发动；玩家一方由玩家点按机体或全体绝招发动（核心 r126 起）。2 号机：在空中飞行（不贴地；v8 起前进只限在敌方据点前缘之前，不再拉到本方据点，分离在本方据点之后时从生成处前进），30 结束后在 rise_ticks 帧内升到 rise_top（世界坐标的高度，MSA 为机体高度一半的上方）、移到本方据点上空，以每帧 descend_speed / 10 下降到离地 hover 后重新出击；置 AreaThrough 与 StageEffectNone（是否不可选为目标由 untargetable 决定，缺省可被选为目标）；不可选为目标时（核心 r127 起），对方以原生瞄准弹（setMoveParamsNearEnemyTarget）攻击的单位把它当作目标：瞄准弹在它比对方最前单位更靠前时转向它，射出过瞄准弹的单位种类在它更靠前时按它计算距离并以远距攻击（近距不发射瞄准弹时）打它；弹体动作每帧改写运动的种类（例如克拉克）不计。损毁：1、3 号机播放 death_animation 后以每帧 crash_speed / 10 前冲（攻击框按绝招组结算，伤害为绝招伤害 × crash_damage，第二参数 99），停住或撞到敌人（v7 起以攻击 ID 判定：冲撞攻击开始后第一次命中即为撞到）时爆炸（death_burst_ticks 帧的爆炸序列；v4 起另在机体各处放 4 团大型单位爆炸 0xff17、播放原生大爆炸音效 253，第 2 帧起不绘制本机）后移除；2 号机向前下方坠落，机体下缘（原点下方 touchdown_offset 世界单位，缺省 40）触地时爆炸移除（v6 起 crash_animation 大于 0 时在触地处播放该动作，其攻击框按 crash_damage 的损毁冲撞伤害结算，并同 1、3 号机放大型爆炸与音效 253）；合体单位播放 death_animation 后在三处爆炸移除。击退（80）播放 knockback_animation。object_width 大于 0 时每帧把单位宽度（原生 getWidthSize 的精灵像素值，乘精灵缩放后为世界单位；用于前线、索敌距离与阻挡）写为该值，供共用一份描述符的单位按各自的待机受击框前缘设宽度（v2，核心 r119；0 为原生 setObjectSize 的值）。bullets 为弹体表，每项 4 个整数 [首个脚本, 个数, 种类, 命中]：种类 1 按所在攻击组的弹速水平飞行，2 以弹速飞向最近的敌方单位，3 按脚本 op7 运动，4 为分离弹体，5（v5）水平射出后追踪最近的敌方单位（第 8 帧起每帧转向至多约 6°，第 120 帧后直飞，速率不变，精灵保持水平不倾斜）；种类加 16 时触地不消失；命中为 0 直接移除，小于 4096 为命中后播放的动作号（播完移除），0xff00–0xfffe 为共用效果编号（0xff00 + n），65536 以上（v6）低 16 位为命中动作号、(值 >> 16) & 255 为同时在弹体下方 40 放出的共用效果 n（同原生派斯戰車的降落伞炸弹）。
doc.EN: MS7 Mission 5 boss UNION (2026-11-01, core r118), ported from the MSA 7.13.0 BattleAction_UnionCombine / Union1 / Union2 / Union3 code (analysis in docs/MS7_M5_UNITS_2026-11-01.md). role 0 is the combined unit and 1-3 are machines 1-3 (internal units); all four give first_unit / second_unit / third_unit (the internal unit keys of the machines: the combined unit spawns and preloads them, machines 1 and 3 use them to find each other). Combined unit: from v3 it takes damage, multiplied by combined_damage_taken / 100 while not hidden (default 100, no reduction; MSA uses Guard, no damage); at the split the machines inherit its current HP ratio; from v4, if it has not split after max_combined_ticks frames since appearing it starts the split by itself while idle or advancing (0 means no limit: it splits only when an enemy comes into range); 10 idle, 20 advance; 30 / 40 / 50 all play divide_animation (no attacks), on frame split_tick spawn the three machines at the facing-relative offsets first_offset / second_offset / third_offset (world units), on the next frame become invisible, untargetable, non-blocking and undamageable behind the own base (from v7, when hidden_animation is above 0 it plays that animation and its minimap marker is set to 0, since native drawing ignores invisibility; with 0 it keeps the last frame of the split); from v8, when ground_follow_count is above 0, the split_bullet bullet and the ground_follow_count effects from script ground_follow_first (the parts of machine 1, which native code only moves horizontally) follow the terrain during the split: the bullet x is taken as the position of machine 1, the height blends from the combined unit's height to the terrain there over the first 16 frames and follows the terrain afterwards, and machine 1 is created at that height, and are removed once all three machines are gone (no recombination). In the unit menu action viewer (from core r130), once the images of the three machines exist (preloaded by the host viewer) this unit creates them at the three offsets and plays hidden_animation; the near, far and special demos put all three into that state at once (machine 1 has no far attack), and this unit returns to idle when all three have finished; bullets use the bullet table in the viewer as well. Bullets of script split_bullet are removed when the combined unit hides. Machines 1 and 3 push each other every frame: when machine 3's front (x + spacing[1]) passes machine 1's rear (x - spacing[2]) the moving one is put spacing[0] apart. 30 / 40 / 50 play near_animation / far_animation / special_animation followed by the attack wait; machine 3's special drops 5 bomb_bullet bombs from high above at frames 16 and 40, within its range and the enemy base front. The machines' specials: on a side controlled by the native AI (BattleControllerEnemy / NetEnemy) they start by themselves once available; on a player's side the player starts them by tapping the machine or with the all-specials command (from core r126). Machine 2 flies (not on the ground; from v8 its forward flight is limited only by the enemy base front and is no longer pulled to the own base, so after a split behind the own base it advances from where it was created); after 30 it rises to the height rise_top (world y; above the screen top by half its body height in MSA) in rise_ticks frames, moves above the own base and descends by descend_speed / 10 per frame to hover above the ground before attacking again; it has AreaThrough and StageEffectNone (untargetable makes it untargetable; targetable by default). When untargetable (from core r127), opposing units that attack with native aimed bullets (setMoveParamsNearEnemyTarget) treat it as a target: aimed bullets turn to it when it is ahead of the opposing front unit, and unit types that have fired aimed bullets measure their distance to it when it is ahead, attacking it with the far attack (when the near attack fires no aimed bullet); types whose bullet action rewrites the motion every frame (for example Clark) do not count. Death: machines 1 and 3 play death_animation and charge forward by crash_speed / 10 per frame (the attack box uses the special group with special damage x crash_damage and second parameter 99), exploding when they stop or hit an enemy (from v7 judged by the attack ID: the first hit after the crash attack starts) (a death_burst_ticks frame sequence; from v4 also four large-unit explosions 0xff17 over the hull and the native big explosion sound 253, the machine no longer drawn from frame 2) before removal; machine 2 dives forward and down and explodes when its lower edge (touchdown_offset world units below the origin, default 40) touches the ground (from v6, when crash_animation is above 0 it plays that animation at the touchdown point, whose attack box deals the crash damage of crash_damage, with the large explosions and sound 253 of machines 1 and 3); the combined unit plays death_animation and explodes in three places. Knockback (80) plays knockback_animation. When object_width is above 0 the unit width (the native getWidthSize value in sprite pixels, world units after the sprite scale; used for the front line, target distance and blocking) is written every frame, so units sharing one descriptor can each take the front edge of their own idle hit box (v2, core r119; 0 keeps the native setObjectSize value). bullets is the bullet table of 4-integer entries [first script, count, kind, hit]: kind 1 flies level at the attack group's bullet speed, 2 flies at that speed towards the nearest enemy unit, 3 follows the script op7 motion, 4 is the divide bullet, 5 (v5) launches level and then homes on the nearest enemy unit (from frame 8 it turns by at most about 6 degrees per frame, flying straight after frame 120, at constant speed, the sprite kept level); kind + 16 keeps the bullet on touching the ground; hit 0 removes it, below 4096 is an animation played before removal, 0xff00-0xfffe is a shared effect id (0xff00 + n), and from 65536 (v6) the low 16 bits are the hit animation and (value >> 16) & 255 a shared effect n placed 40 below the bullet at the same time (as the native PARACHUTE TRUCK bomb).

doc.ZS: MS7 任务 5 新单位 Energy Pod（能量弹，2026-11-02，核心 r131；设计与示意动画见 docs/MS7_ENERGY_POD_2026-11-02.md）。role 0 为组单位（出场的单位），1 为球单位（内部单位，ball_unit 指向它；两者都写 ball_unit）。组单位出场即在编队位置生成三颗球（等级同组单位，开战时随组单位预载），随即隐去（不绘制，播放 hidden_animation；不可选为目标、不阻挡、不受伤、不击退），作为全组的控制者，三颗球都消失时移除。三颗球为空中单位（NoTarget、DontToche、AreaThrough，地面单位从其下方走过；原生瞄准弹的单位以对方最前的球为目标，同 union 的 2 号机），不击退、无绝招（组与球都置 DontSpAttack）。流程（世界单位 / tick，朝右一方为准，朝左一方镜像）：编队中心在地形以上 height，三颗球在半径 radius 的圆上（顶角朝上；二球上下竖排，一球在中心不旋转）；中立时以组单位的移速（状态词 5）前进、编队以每周 neutral_period tick 逆时针旋转，球播放 idle_animation（三个相位）；最近的敌方单位或据点前缘进入水平“近距射程”（状态词 6）时停止前进（此处为发起攻击的位置），转速在 spin_up tick 内线性加速到每周 period tick，随即播放 about_animation（about_ticks），之后按存活的球数变色（三球黄、蓝、红，二球黄、红，一球红；charged_animation 起各色），再经 charged_hold（单球 single_hold）tick 依次出发（间隔 launch_gap）：目标为出发时离编队中心最近、且水平距离在 target_range 以内的敌方单位或据点前缘（v2，0 为不限；第一颗出发时范围内没有敌人则取消本次出击：各球播放收尾动作、在原处减速后回到中立并等待 reattack_wait；已有球出发时其余的球沿用本次出击的目标），以 dive_speed / 10 飞向其脚下地面（球底触地），在触地处放 bump_effect、黄 / 蓝球放 ring_effect、红球放 fire_effect（纯为效果）并按镜像角度弹回出发时的高度，播放 dive_animation（攻击框，整段一个攻击 ID）与尾迹 trail_effect；俯冲与反弹中撞到的敌方单位与据点各受近距组伤害（状态词 15；目标数词 17，每个目标每颗球每次出击一次；属性黄 0、蓝 2、红 1，写入球的状态词 21）。到达的球播放 recover_animation，以发起攻击位置关于目标的镜像为中心、在同一圆上旋转等待其余的球（取不越过已到者的最近空位），全部到齐 join_wait tick 后转速在 spin_down tick 内线性减速到中立转速，以组单位的移速飞回发起攻击的位置（途中按中立转速旋转）；回到原位后敌人仍在范围内时隔 reattack_wait tick 再攻击，否则恢复中立前进。被击毁的球在原地播放 wreck_animation（原色或所变颜色，由该动作脚本放原生爆炸与音效）后移除，画在存活的球之下；其余的球在编队或集合圆上于 regroup_ticks tick 内均分，只剩一球时移到圆心、不再旋转；已变色的球不改色，已有球出发后留在编队圆上的球不调整，途中被击毁的球不再被等待。从开始加速到减速结束（含俯冲、反弹与集合等待），球受到的伤害乘 attack_damage_taken / 100（缺省 100 不减）。charge_sound 在变色时、launch_sound 在每颗出发与落地时、flame_sound 在红球落地时播放。弹回终点与集合中心的 x 限在发起攻击的位置前后 2 × 近距射程（弹回终点另加半径）之内，并限在双方据点之间（核心 r132 起）。单位菜单的动作演示中，组单位在球的图像已建立后（宿主演示预载）生成三颗球；近距演示为一次完整的出击、集合与飞回（目标为前方近距射程处的地面），结束后回到待机。recover_ticks 为收尾动作的 tick 数（只用于说明，核心以动作播完为准）。
doc.EN: MS7 Mission 5 unit Energy Pod (2026-11-02, core r131; design and preview animation in docs/MS7_ENERGY_POD_2026-11-02.md). role 0 is the group unit (the deployed unit) and 1 the pod unit (internal, referenced by ball_unit; both give ball_unit). On appearing the group unit creates three pods in formation (same level, preloaded with the group at battle start) and hides itself (not drawn, plays hidden_animation; untargetable, non-blocking, undamageable, no knockback); it controls the whole group and is removed once all three pods are gone. The pods are air units (NoTarget, DontToche, AreaThrough: ground units walk under them; units firing native aimed shots target the foremost enemy pod, as with union machine 2); no knockback and no special attack (DontSpAttack on group and pods). Flow (world units / ticks, for the right-facing side; mirrored for the other side): the formation centre is height above the terrain and the pods lie on a circle of radius radius (apex up; two pods stacked vertically, one pod at the centre without rotation); in neutral the group advances at its move speed (status word 5) while the formation turns anticlockwise once every neutral_period ticks and the pods play idle_animation (three phases); when the nearest enemy unit or the front of the enemy base comes within the near range (status word 6) horizontally it stops (the attack position), the turn rate rises linearly over spin_up ticks to once every period ticks, the pods play about_animation (about_ticks) and then change colour by the number of live pods (three: yellow, blue, red; two: yellow, red; one: red; charged_animation plus the colour index) and after charged_hold (single pod: single_hold) ticks leave one by one every launch_gap ticks: each flies at dive_speed / 10 to the ground under the enemy unit or base front nearest to the formation centre at departure and within target_range of it horizontally (v2; 0 means no limit; if nothing is in range when the first pod is due to leave, the sortie is cancelled: the pods play the recover animation, spin down in place, return to neutral and wait reattack_wait; once a pod has left, the others reuse this sortie's target) (pod bottom touching the ground), leaves bump_effect there plus ring_effect (yellow / blue) or fire_effect (red), which are effects only, and bounces back at the mirrored angle to its starting height, playing dive_animation (attack box, one attack ID for the whole flight) with trail_effect; enemy units and the base it touches on the way down or up take the near-attack damage (status word 15; target count word 17; each target once per pod per sortie; attribute yellow 0, blue 2, red 1, written to the pod status word 21). Arriving pods play recover_animation and turn on a circle of the same radius centred on the mirror of the attack position about the target, taking the nearest free slot not past those already there; join_wait ticks after all have arrived the turn rate falls linearly over spin_down ticks to the neutral rate and the group flies back to the attack position at its move speed (turning at the neutral rate); there it attacks again after reattack_wait ticks if an enemy is still in range, otherwise it resumes the neutral advance. A destroyed pod plays wreck_animation in place (plain or its colour; the script adds the native explosion and sound) and is removed, drawn below the live pods; the others spread evenly on the formation or gathering circle over regroup_ticks ticks, or move to the centre and stop turning when one is left; pods that have changed colour keep it, pods still on the formation circle are not moved once one has left, and pods destroyed in flight are not waited for. From the start of the spin-up to the end of the spin-down (including the dive, bounce and gathering), damage taken by the pods is multiplied by attack_damage_taken / 100 (default 100, no reduction). charge_sound plays on the colour change, launch_sound on each departure and landing, flame_sound on a red landing. The x of each bounce end point and of the gathering centre is kept within 2 × the near range of the attack position (plus the radius for bounce end points) and between the two bases (from core r132). In the unit menu action viewer the group creates the pods once their images exist (preloaded by the host viewer); the near demo is one full sortie, gathering and return (target: the ground at the near range ahead), then back to neutral. recover_ticks is the length of the recover animation (documentation only; the core waits for the animation to end).

doc.ZS: 5 连发马克斯奈尔类（原生 BattleAction_McsnlFive）的攻击轮数：原生每次攻击动作播完时把本机的攻击计数加 1，满 2 轮后飞离战场并移除；本行为把轮数改为 rounds（缺省 2，同原生）。每架各自计数，领队与 formation_wingmen 指定的僚机单位须各自带此行为。
doc.EN: Attack rounds for the Regimental MH-6s class (native BattleAction_McsnlFive): natively each aircraft adds 1 to its attack counter whenever an attack animation finishes and flies off the battlefield (and is removed) after 2 rounds; this behavior sets the number of rounds to rounds (default 2, same as native). Each aircraft counts its own rounds, so the leader and the wingman unit given by formation_wingmen both need this behavior.
